text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not long before Mejiro Bright is to run in
the
Hopeful Stakes, good news arrives
from the
Mejiro estate.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Mejiro Dober! Mejiro Dober has
claimed an
incredible victory at this
junior year G1!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She has defeated the favorite to win,
Seeking the
Pearl! Now the spotlight is
on Mejiro Bright to
continue this winning
streak!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! You're a force to be reckoned
with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. It's up to us to follow
up her
success. Ready? And... woooo. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Woo? How can you be so relaxed when
you're
about to run in a G1 yourself? I
was so nervous
my knees were knocking
together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is she... all right? Don't you
think you
should crack down on her a
bit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, not you too. Is Bright's
personality
contagious?
choice_data_list: いや～、このままでいいんじゃないか？
いや～、このままでいいんじゃない？
choice_data_list_en: Well, isn't it fine just the way it is?
Well, isn't it fine just the way it is?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It will all work out. Trainer, you agree,
yes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through our training sessions, I've found
myself
getting more and more confident.
I'm starting to
believe in Mejiro Bright's
finishing dash.
choice_data_list: ……ああ、落ち着いて走ればいい
……うん、落ち着いて走ればいいよ
choice_data_list_en: ...Yeah, just stay calm and run your race.
...Yeah, just stay calm when you run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're still not quite on solid ground, but
she
always soars in that final stretch.
And I know this
race will be no different.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Thank you for believing in me, Trainer...
It brings
to mind a memory from long
ago.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Back when I was very little... When she
cheered
me on.)

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what happened, Bright? What's with
the long
face?

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
S-someone said that an Umamusume like
me
could never run fast enough to win...

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text:
So I tried to rush ahead, but then I fell
over...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. So that's what happened. But
Bright, you
shouldn't worry about things
like that.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No one knows if you can run fast or not.
You're
not even grown up yet, so it's
way too early to
tell.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Your life as a racer is just beginning.
Yours and
Dober's.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Prove them wrong by getting better
every day.
Can you do that?

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Did you hurt yourself when you fell? Can
you
show me?

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: Show you? Okay...

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, not even a scratch! You're
all fine.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright, I think you might have strong
bones.
You've been drinking all of your
milk!

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: My bones? They're strong?

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, I can tell! They're just like
mine! You're
gonna be pumping iron like
me in no time.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You don't have a thing to worry about.
Your
future is bright, and you'll get
there at your own
pace.

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The way you run will be your own.
Right?

text_block_list.name: Young Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Ryan, I finally found someone. Someone
who
believes in me, who will wait for
me.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer... Ryan... I will run today for you
both.)
